summary: No installer-harmful behavior observed in tailwind-keyframes@2.0.6
details: The package tailwind-keyframes@2.0.6 was scanned across 8 files and no indicators of supply-chain attack were found. No install/postinstall lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer-side credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores), no environment-variable scraping, no hardcoded attacker endpoints, no obfuscated payloads, and no silent-relay or backdoor mechanisms were observed. Behavior is consistent with a benign Tailwind CSS keyframes utility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
